frontmatter.title: Heart and Brain, No Hands
frontmatter.dek: On losing the dopamine of coding and finding your identity when AI does the work your hands used to love.

frontmatter.title: Apple Sign-In and the issue we faced with Expo
frontmatter.dek: Now, Apple has mandated to provide Apple Sign-In as an equivalent option if your app is providing other social logins(FB, Gmail Twitter, etc) as well. In this guide I tried to simplify the entire process and how we resolved an issue we faced while using Expo for Apple Signin
